note: Description taken from Hill's 1925 original description of Eutermes graveolus (in English), including the alate, soldier and worker; type locality Darwin, Northern Territory, also collected on Bathurst Island; the author treats populations from Magnetic Island, Queensland and elsewhere as a local race of this species. The species builds arboreal nests. The original is in English and the BHL scan was OCR'd, with occasional misread hyphens and measurement digits (e.g. the hyphen ¬), restored here from context; values that cannot be determined are not cited. The species was then placed in Eutermes and is now in Nasutitermes.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Very close to E. exitiosus but smaller (alate with wings 15.00—15.75 mm); antennae 15-segmented, compound eyes much larger with coarser facets, head shorter and more or less paler, bristles on head and body denser, pronotum longer and broader, wings distinctly shorter and paler near the base; it differs from E. yarrabahensis in the smaller body, the smaller, paler and less hairy head, the shorter and paler wings, the smaller compound eyes, the narrower pronotum and the antennae with 1 segment fewer. The soldier cannot be reliably distinguished from that of E. exitiosus.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Very close to E. exitiosus but smaller; head shorter, more or less paler; compound eyes much larger with coarser facets; bristles on head and body denser; pronotum longer and broader; wings distinctly shorter and paler (especially near the base), the first two veins distinctly more widely separated at the base. Measurements: body length (with wings) 15.00—15.75 mm; without wings 7.50—8.00 mm; head length (to the end of the labrum) 1.50 mm; head length (to the frontoclypeal suture) 1.02 mm; head width 1.42 mm; antennal length (15 segments) 2.00 mm; compound eye vertical diameter 0.493 mm, transverse diameter 0.595 mm; pronotum length 0.85 mm, width 1.42 mm; fore wing length 12.50 mm, width 3.50 mm; hind wing length 12.00 mm, width 3.75 mm; hind tibia length 1.70 mm. The type colony also contained one individual with wings only 13.50 mm long and several with wings 8.00—9.00 mm long, with distinctly reduced wings, abnormal specimens.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: No reliable character distinguishes it from the soldier of E. exitiosus; individuals from different colonies vary in head colour and size as in that species. Measurements: body length 4.00 mm; head length 1.73 mm; head width 0.97 mm; antennal length (13 segments) 1.53—2.10 mm; hind tibia length 1.14 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Very similar to the worker of E. exitiosus, but the head is mostly darker with a larger dark area (extending further laterally and posteriorly); the two species cannot be separated on this character. Measurements: body length 5.00 mm; head length (to the end of the labrum) 1.19 mm; head length (to the frontoclypeal suture) 0.97 mm; head width 1.36 mm; pronotum length 0.28 mm, width 0.68 mm; antennal length (14 segments) 1.25 mm; hind tibia length 1.16 mm.
